name: Custom website development
summary: Fast, custom websites in Next.js and React, built to rank and to send every lead into your CRM.
answer: Custom website development is designing and coding a website from scratch rather than adapting a template. HTH builds custom sites in Next.js and React that load fast, are structured for search engines and AI answer engines, and connect every form and booking straight into your CRM. It's for businesses that have outgrown a template or need features a page builder can't handle.
whoFor: Businesses whose site is slow, dated or hard to update
Companies that need custom features, calculators or portals
Brands where site speed and SEO directly affect revenue
Agencies that need a reliable Next.js development partner

problem.heading: Your website looks fine but doesn't do its job.
problem.body: It loads slowly on mobile, ranks for nothing useful, and enquiries arrive in an inbox nobody checks. Every change means waiting on a developer or fighting a page builder.

deliverables.title: Structure and copy
deliverables.detail: Sitemap, page structure and conversion-focused copy, written for people and search engines.

deliverables.title: Design
deliverables.detail: A design system and page designs in your brand, approved before development.

deliverables.title: Next.js build
deliverables.detail: A fast, accessible site with clean code, hosted on Vercel.

deliverables.title: Content editing
deliverables.detail: A simple way to edit content, from MDX files to a headless CMS if you need one.

deliverables.title: CRM integration
deliverables.detail: Forms, bookings and chat wired into your CRM with source tracking.

deliverables.title: SEO foundations
deliverables.detail: Metadata, schema markup, sitemap, analytics and Core Web Vitals in the green.

process.title: Discover
process.detail: Goals, audience, competitors and the actions the site must drive.

process.title: Design
process.detail: Structure, wireframes and visual design, approved page by page.

process.title: Build
process.detail: Development on a staging link you can review at any time.

process.title: Launch
process.detail: Redirects, tracking, speed checks, then go-live and a 30-day support window.

timeline: 4 to 8 weeks for most business websites.

faqs.question: Why Next.js instead of WordPress?
faqs.answer: Next.js sites are faster, more secure and more flexible for custom features. WordPress is easier if you want a large plugin ecosystem and to edit everything yourself. We build both and recommend based on your needs.

faqs.question: Can we edit the content ourselves?
faqs.answer: Yes. We set up the editing method that fits your team, from simple files to a full CMS.

faqs.question: Will we lose our Google rankings when we switch?
faqs.answer: Not if the migration is done properly. We map every old URL to its new one with redirects and keep what's already ranking.
